rules: Three recommendations a week, and never a fourth — however good the week has been.
When the check-in says the week is already full, the cap drops to one and the app says why.
Nothing is suggested that costs more minutes than the capacity answers allow.
A recommendation is not repeated within four weeks.
Every recommendation names the pillar and the skill it is aimed at.
Nothing therapeutic, nothing diagnostic. These are ordinary play and family suggestions.
Nothing that needs buying. 'You will need' may only name what is already in most homes.
